Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for signing up — next steps

Hi Ellie —

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood Inference trial! We received your request and have provisioned a trial workspace for your team. Here are a few quick next steps to get the most out of the trial:

• Start with the Quickstart guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart (10–15 minutes)
• Check the sample prompts and evaluation harness in your workspace
• If you'd like a short walkthrough, pick a 30-minute slot with our team here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo/30min?cid=RDW-8421

We’ve also attached a short overview deck and a trial checklist to help you prepare. If you already have specific use cases or data constraints, include that in the booking form so we can tailor the session.

Attachments: demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB), trial-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 14KB)

— Redwood Inference Team
https://redwood.ai

• Tue Jun 1, 10:00–10:30 AM PDT
• Tue Jun 1, 2:00–2:30 PM PDT
• Wed Jun 2, 9:00–9:30 AM PDT

Quick notes:
• If you want a technical deep dive on integration and privacy controls, I’ll loop in Soojin (cc’d) for the call.
• I added a short mutual-action plan draft to the shared folder — link below — to align milestones for the trial.

Booking link (same as the auto-responder): https://calendly.com/redwood/demo/30min?cid=RDW-8421
